newsitem.title: CHINA: Hong Kong's Hang Seng jumps sharply to record high.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong's Hang Seng jumps sharply to record high.

text.p: Hong Kong's Hang Seng Index jumped 137 points or 0.89 percent to a new record high of 15,508 in afternoon trade.
The index eased slightly later to trade 132 points higher at 15,502.
"The market is being led by HSBC and the major utilities, chiefly Hongkong Telecom," said Antony Mak, sales director at Vickers Ballas. "But I can't give any reason for the interest in utilities."

HSBC Holdings leaped to HK$255.00 then eased slightly to trade HK$5.00 higher at HK$254.00 on heavy turnover of HK$761 million. Hongkong Telecom surged to an all time high of HK$19.70, then eased to trade HK$1.00 higher at HK$19.60.
Brokers also said red chip trading featured in the market.
Shanghai Industrial leaped HK$3.10 higher to a new high of HK$51.00 on moderate trade of HK$104 million.
